name: Harbour
description: The home waters with a sheltered bay: rocky arms close in round the lighthouse.
special: A new version of the original world: the same start, buoy route, open ocean, six fishing spots, rocks and seven islands (lighthouse, pines, autumn and four more), plus eight new rock islands: bay-arm-1 to bay-arm-7 and wims-ledge, and a Lighthouse_Bay object round the lighthouse. The standard world: owned and used from the start (the game's own generated world, "Wake", is a chart now). It fishes the same 32 fish as the home waters (fish: w_001-harbour).

name: Frostmere
description: A cold, quiet sea of steep snowy cliffs, a winding fjord, a blue glacier and drifting ice.
special: Made from blender/worlds/w_002-frostmere.blend. Tall white ridges (peaks up to 2.0) form the Long Fjord, a winding channel about 1.3 wide that ends at Ezra's Inlet, where Ezra the cartographer lives in a hut on stilts. A wider way leaves the inlet to the north-east. Ezra's dock is the selling point (Dock_Ezra) and is solid (the Ezra_Dock group). Waterfall Cove, under the tallest cliffs, has a sea cave you can sail into (the cave roof is a prop, Cave_Roof). A blocky glacier with broken ice chunks, the Icefield of drifting floes and small bergs, the Black Skerries, five low pine holms and three outer crags near the fjord; on the far side a ring of eight snowy islands (most with pines) round the Cold Deep, the open water at the south pole. Seven orange survey flags, and markers the game does not read yet: Area_*, Quest_CompassPiece_1-4 and Resident_Ezra. Suggested mood if the game ever reads one: colder sea colour, snow instead of rain, a pale low sun, the aurora at night.

name: The Sunken Ruins
description: An old stone city sunk into a warm green swamp: canals, a leaning bell tower and mangroves in the ruins.
special: Made from blender/worlds/w_003-sunken-ruins.blend. You arrive outside a flooded city gate and sail in under its arch (0.96 clearance; the arch is a prop, Gate_Arch). The Canal Quarter: eight roofless houses with canals 1.2 wide between them, several ways through. The Drowned Plaza (a toppled bronze statue, the top of a fountain), the leaning Bell Tower (3.3 high, the landmark), the Temple Steps, the Deep Cistern (entered from the west), and the Old Hulls: six half-sunken boats with a long shape carved on each stern. Sigrid the boatbuilder's yard in a half-sunken warehouse, with her unfinished boat in three separate stages (Sigrid_Boat_Keel, Sigrid_Boat_Planks, Sigrid_Boat_Mast; all shown for now). Her dock is the selling point (Dock_Sigrid) and is solid (the Sigrid_Dock group). Mangroves, lily pads, and mangrove islets and ruin fragments round open water on the far side. Markers the game does not read yet: Area_*, Quest_KeelTimber, Quest_SailCloth, Quest_Planks, HousePlot and Resident_Sigrid. It fishes the home waters' fish until it has its own set.

name: The Reef
description: A sunny atoll: a broken ring of sand and pale reef round a huge shallow turquoise lagoon, with deep blue sea outside.
special: Made from blender/worlds/w_004-reef.blend on top of the Wake base file. You arrive outside the main gap in the ring; two more gaps lead in as well. Its Sea_ layers colour the water: turquoise lagoon, deep blue outside, the round dark Blue Hole. The Palm Keys with two hammocks and the house plot, the Coral Gardens, Shipwreck Shoal with the bow of an old boat and a crate of coral cuttings (Seedlings_Crate), and the Blue Hole ringed with coral. Marisol the dyer's stilt house with lines of dyed cloth. Her dock is the selling point (Dock_Marisol) and is solid (the Marisol_Dock group). 25 coral clusters (Coral_nn, in Rocks so they are solid), all pale; each names its coloured material (Reef_CoralColour_nn) for the replanting quest, which the game does not have yet. Markers the game does not read yet: Area_*, Quest_CoralBed_1-5, Quest_Seedlings, HousePlot and Resident_Marisol. It fishes the home waters' fish until it has its own set.

name: The Riverlands
description: Rolling green hills with slow rivers, reed beds and willow lakes winding between them.
special: Made from blender/worlds/w_005-riverlands.blend on top of the Wake base file. Mostly land (about two thirds): you start in the River Mouth and sail up the Meanders; the rivers (1.0-1.6 wide) form one network with a loop (Meanders -> Narrows -> Reedmarsh -> Willow Lake -> back to the Meanders) and a long river round the far side past the Hollow. Wide Water (the biggest lake), Willow Lake (willows, lily pads with white flowers), Reedmarsh (three reed islets with channels either side), the Narrows (a rocky gorge under a rope bridge, 0.78 clearance) and the old Stone Bridge (arch springs at 0.74). Bram the ropemaker's mill on the millpond, with the ropewalk beside it. His dock is the selling point (Dock_Bram) and is solid (the Bram_Dock group). The mill wheel (Mill_Wheel, pivot on its axle) is jammed (Mill_Jam): the game does not turn it yet. Markers the game does not read yet: Area_*, Quest_Logjam, Quest_WheelPaddle_1-3 (the paddles float as WheelPaddle_1-3), HousePlot and Resident_Bram. It has its own 32 fish (fish: w_005-riverlands): river fish, with the times of day and the weather of the design brief. Map areas, rod groups and the lamp / mill wheel conditions are not mechanics of the game yet.
